headline: Real Madrid Defeats Celta Vigo 2-1 Following Late Carlos Espi Goal
metaDescription: Real Madrid secured a 2-1 victory over Celta Vigo in their latest LaLiga match, overcoming an initial deficit thanks to a decisive goal by Carlos Espi.
aiSummaryBullets: Real Madrid overcame a deficit to beat Celta Vigo 2-1 in their LaLiga encounter.
Carlos Espi scored the match-winning goal for Real Madrid late in the game.
The result comes as part of the 2026/2027 Spanish football league season.
aiContextParagraph: The match between Real Madrid and Celta Vigo served as a fixture for the 13th round of the 2026/2027 LaLiga season. Despite falling behind early in the contest, Real Madrid managed to mount a comeback to claim all three points. The decisive moment occurred late in the match when Carlos Espi scored to put his side ahead, ultimately sparing the team from a potential draw or loss. The encounter drew media attention as the club sought to maintain its standing within the league rankings. This match continues the long-standing tradition of competition within Spain's top football tier, with coverage tracking both the tactical developments and the final result on the pitch. Real Madrid continues its campaign in the domestic competition while balancing commitments across other tournaments throughout the current football year.
